name: RV repair and service

pf.license.need: if: where the state registers repair shops or certifies technicians; a propane (LP-gas) certificate where the state requires one; an EPA certificate for refrigerant work
ask: The shop's repair-shop registration number, where the state has one
Each technician's certificates for the work they do: a propane certificate where the state requires one, and an EPA certificate for refrigerant work
Industry certificates (RV technician or inspector), shown only as what the business says
pf.license.who: both: the shop, and each person
pf.license.check: the state's license lookup; where there's none, a person on Rosie's team checks within 1 business day
pf.license.blocks: nothing waits on a license (D96): the business and each person go live once set up and the owner says yes; a job the owner says needs a license they don't have isn't booked
pf.license.every_state: refrigerant work (roof A/C, refrigerators, chassis A/C) only by a person with the EPA certificate for it
pf.license.renewals: optional reminders the owner sets; a license the owner says has lapsed pauses that person's new bookings for that work (the owner's word, never a check)
pf.license.insurance: garage liability and coverage for customers' RVs in the shop's care, as the business says; shown as given by the business, not checked by Rosie
pf.license.otherwise: identity checked, and 'license: what the business says'

pf.services.pattern: drop-off: the RV is left at the shop and picked up when it's ready (jobs can take days)

list.name: Diagnosis (A/C, refrigerator, furnace, water heater, slide-out, leveling jacks, electrical, leaks)
list.price: one price (the example shop: $149), OK'd in writing on the drop-off page
list.length: a set time, like 1 hour; more time is new work that needs a new yes

list.name: Repair after a diagnosis
list.price: quoted at the visit: a written estimate with the most it can cost, signed before any repair
list.after: at the counter, or the bill Rosie texts with the ready text

list.name: Battery check, tire pressure check, smoke and carbon monoxide alarm test, fuse and bulb swap, brake and bearing check, slide-out lube and check
list.price: one price from the shop's board (the example shop: battery check $35)
list.length: 30 to 60 minutes; wait or drop off

list.name: Water pump replacement, water heater service
list.price: one price from the shop's list

list.name: Propane system leak test and safety check
Roof seal inspection and reseal
list.price: inspection: one price; reseal: quoted from the roof's size, signed before the work
list.length: an hour for the inspection; a reseal takes a day or two
list.place: at the shop; also mobile (dry weather)

list.name: Winterizing and de-winterizing
list.price: one price, from the shop's list

list.name: Awning and body-part replacement
list.price: quoted from photos; the parts are ordered after the deposit (the example: $640, $160 deposit)
list.length: a few days to a few weeks, for the parts

list.name: Tow-in
list.price: the tow's own price, booked with a towing company the customer picks, plus the diagnosis
list.place: the RV arrives by tow at any time, keys in the key box

list.name: Mobile RV repair (at a home, a storage lot or a campground)
list.price: one price, quoted from photos and the RV's details, or quoted at the visit
list.before: a card saved for the trip fee; nothing else taken
list.after: Rosie texts the bill, or the saved card is charged at DONE

list.name: Pre-purchase or pre-trip inspection
list.place: at the shop, or where the RV for sale is parked

pf.services.capacity: a daily cap on diagnoses (the example shop: 3 a day); one bay and one technician per job; a length and height limit for the bays (the example shop: up to 40 feet and 13 feet)
pf.services.drop_off_window: drop-off slots by the shop's daily number (the example shop: 3 RVs a day), shown as drop-off times with no technician named; big rigs by appointment; plus an after-hours key box once the drop-off page is signed
pf.services.living_in: the shop's rule, set by the owner: nobody lives in the RV while it is at the shop, and pets are never left inside; the customer says where they will stay
pf.services.loaners: none: the shop lends no RVs
pf.services.warranty: on the receipt: 90 days on labor; parts as the maker covers them
pf.services.nobody_home: a mobile job on a parked RV can be done with nobody there: the keys or the lockbox are used as agreed, and DONE comes with a photo; at a campground, the campground's rules apply

before_times: What is the RV doing, and since when? In the customer's own words
Type (motorhome, travel trailer, fifth wheel, camper van), year, make and model
Length and height, and the mileage if it has an engine
Any propane smell, carbon monoxide alarm, burning smell or water near the wiring?
For a mobile job: where it's parked (home, storage lot, campground and site), and whether it has power and water hookups
after_time: Where will the customer stay while it's at the shop? Nobody stays in it, and no pets are left inside
Old parts back? Yes or no
Anything the technician should know, like when the leak or the noise happens
secure_page_only: The campground gate code and the site, or the lockbox code
Someone else who may say yes to the estimate, named in writing
pf.questions.who_may_book: an adult: the RV's owner, or someone the owner lets bring it in; a renter or a borrower can book a diagnosis, but a repair needs the owner's yes, named in writing

pf.safety.stop_action: 'Get everyone out and away, and call 911' and the generic emergency steps; no booking
dont_drive_words: a tire with a bulge, or tread coming off
a wheel that wobbles or smokes
smoke or steam from the engine
a burning smell or sparks from the wiring
a slide-out or step stuck out
pf.safety.dont_drive_action: Rosie says: park somewhere safe, switch the engine off, switch the power off where it is safe to, and don't drive or tow it. The booking can go on as a tow-in or a mobile visit.
pf.safety.mobile_stops: a propane or fuel leak, no level and safe place to work, or a roof job in rain, wind or lightning: the technician stops, and the job moves to the shop or another day

pf.first_steps.required: none before the visit; the diagnosis fee is OK'd in writing on the drop-off page when booking
at_check_in: A recall check on the VIN
The walk-around, the odometer and the generator hours, and photos
The propane tanks shut at the valve
prep_for_reminder: Bring every key, including the compartment and storage-bay keys
Empty the refrigerator, and take out food, valuables and pets
Know where you'll stay while it's in the shop
For a mobile job: level ground, power and water hookups if you have them, and room for the slide-outs

pf.visit.check_in: a drop-off: the customer gives the check-in code at the counter when leaving the RV. A key-box drop-off or a tow-in has no code: the technician texts IN once the RV and keys are found. Mobile: the code at the RV, as at any door.
pf.visit.intake: the odometer and the generator hours, the keys, a walk-around with photos, the problem in the customer's words, old parts back or not, the propane tanks shut
pf.visit.recall_check: the VIN is checked for open safety recalls at check-in; an open recall is told to the customer, and its fix is free at the maker's dealers
pf.visit.diagnosis: the OK'd fee covers a set time; more time is new work that needs a new yes; no answer is never a yes
pf.visit.estimate: written, with parts and labor lines, new or used, maker or aftermarket parts, and the most it can cost; signed before any repair
pf.visit.added_work: anything over the signed estimate needs a new yes before it's done, logged with the time, the phone and the new total
pf.visit.ready: READY texts the customer the total, the pick-up hours and any storage terms
pf.visit.pick_up: the RV goes only to the customer, or someone they name; the work and any old parts are shown, with a water or leak test where it applies
pf.visit.done_proof: the drop-off code, or IN, checks the RV in; READY and the pick-up close it
pf.visit.late_drop_off: the shop's rule: diagnosed the same day if there's room, or else the next day
pf.visit.pick_up_and_delivery: not offered: an RV arrives under its own power or by a tow the customer books

pf.money.before: the starting answer is nothing taken; the diagnosis fee is OK'd in writing, not charged; a special-order part (an awning) can take a deposit on a price set before the visit
pf.money.after: paid at the counter at pick-up, the shop's own way; or the bill Rosie texts with the ready text, if the owner turns it on
pf.money.mobile: a card saved for the trip fee, kept only for a late cancel or a no-show; the bill after DONE, or the saved card charged at DONE
pf.money.deposit: a parts deposit only on a price set before the visit; deposit cap: from the state form
pf.money.storage: a daily storage fee only after the free working days that follow the ready text, told before drop-off, and only once the owner confirms it; storage limits: from the state form
pf.money.after_a_no: after a no to the estimate, only the OK'd diagnosis, plus any putting-back-together the state's rules allow
pf.money.fees: no cancel or no-show fee to start at the shop; the mobile trip fee is the late-cancel and no-show fee
pf.money.cancel: free until the cutoff (the example: 2 days before); a late cancel or a no-show keeps only the trip fee on a mobile visit, and the owner can turn a shop fee on for long jobs
pf.money.tax: the shop's tax rate on parts and labor

never_in_text: The campground gate code or the lockbox code
pf.messages.minors: texts about a teen's RV go to the parent who booked

pf.staff.licenses: each technician's certificates for the work they do: a propane certificate where the state requires one; an EPA certificate for refrigerant work, in every state; industry certificates as the business says
pf.staff.supervision: an apprentice works only while a certified technician who may supervise them is on, where the state's rules require it
pf.staff.who_oks: the owner or the service writer OKs estimates, added work and storage fees
pf.staff.stand_in: only someone certified for that kind of work

pf.rules.written_estimate: switch: a written estimate before work, above an amount: from the state form
pf.rules.written_ok_for_diagnosis: switch: a written OK for the diagnosis fee: from the state form
pf.rules.overage: Rosie's rule: never over the signed estimate without a new yes; no state leeway is used
pf.rules.choose_any_shop: switch: a line saying the customer may pick any shop: from the state form
pf.rules.old_parts: switch: offer the old parts back: from the state form; warranty or core-exchange parts are shown, not given
pf.rules.show_number: switch: the shop's state number on estimates and receipts: from the state form
pf.rules.work_order: switch: what the work order must carry, like the odometer and the problem in the customer's words: from the state form
pf.rules.storage_notice: switch: storage terms told before drop-off, and the free days: from the state form
pf.rules.unclaimed_vehicle: switch: the state's garage-lien and abandoned-vehicle steps; the owner runs them, and Rosie sends only the notices the owner OKs
pf.rules.propane_work: propane system work and leak tests only by a person with the propane certificate, where the state requires one
pf.rules.recalls: the maker's dealers fix open recalls for free; the shop tells the customer and doesn't do the recall work itself

applies: A no-show at drop-off: no fee to start
The RV gets worse before drop-off: the don't-drive steps, then a tow-in or a mobile visit
More work found, like rotted wood behind a leak
Someone is living in the RV at drop-off
The RV isn't picked up: storage, then written notice
The problem comes back under warranty
pf.edges.handling: each the generic way, with the plug-in's words; the owner confirms every fee

A.other: Others (a bank, a parent, the maker's dealer)

NEW Tue Oct 27 2026 (REDESIGN 2, professions pass P3, batch D2). Built from the refitted auto-repair parent (set "from"); no old flowchart or base plug-in existed, so the plug-in is built from the trade's norm.
Why auto-repair: an RV is left at a shop with a written estimate OK'd before any repair and picked up when ready (jobs can run for days), and a mobile technician goes to a home, a storage lot or a campground.
Facts dropoff, extrawork; no switches; settings A set start (a drop-off time), B 2-hour window, cutoff 2 days before (big rigs, travel). Sent now is OFF: RV repair is booked for a set time or a window. So S2-30 branch 1 (and B7-55, B8-58 'Sent now') are off, S2-30 and S1-21 (flow B and the more lines of flow A) carry words that say nothing is sent now, and S1-21's 'Jobs sent now' row is gone.
Money A (4): visit|none|counter (main: a $149 diagnosis OK'd on the drop-off page, then a signed estimate: $487 roof A/C repair + $96 slide-out seal treatment, the $149 inside the $487), list|none|counter ($35 battery check), visit|none|bill, list|none|bill. Money B (4): list|card|bill (main: $179 water pump replacement, $89 trip fee as the late-cancel and no-show fee), visit|card|bill (Leak repair: a roof leak priced at the visit; quote lines roof sealant $165 + vent seal $80), list|card|card, photos|deposit|bill ($640 awning from photos, $160 deposit for the parts, $480 rest). No A photos path (master S1-13 shows a $20 deposit for it in flow A). No hold, no full price.
Real RV points in the plug-in: bay length and height limits; nobody lives in the RV at the shop and no pets left inside (the owner's rule); the propane tanks shut at check-in; propane and refrigerant work only by a person with the certificate the law needs (propane certificate where the state asks, EPA certificate in every state); a renter or borrower can book a diagnosis, but a repair needs the owner's yes in writing; stop words are fire, a propane smell or hissing, a carbon monoxide alarm, someone hurt or shocked (911, everyone out); don't-drive words are brakes that grab, a tire bulge, a wobbling or smoking wheel, smoke or steam, burning wiring, a stuck slide-out, a fuel leak; a roof job stops in rain, wind or lightning; a tow-in is booked by the customer with a towing company (no pick-up and delivery); a 90-day labor warranty.
Kinds of work in sign-up: mobile RV repair + RV inspections (an inspector certificate shown as what the business says) for Lee Mobile RV, and the RV service shop as the second company. Names under 20 characters. License numbers are EX-xxxx style. Extra rename pairs as in motorcycle (found by reading the joined flows).
Own steps: A8-x01/x02 recall check, A8-x03 to x05 the diagnosis inside the OK'd hour, A8-x09 a late part (Alex plans where to stay).
Self-checks: (1) after turning sent now off I searched the joined text for 'sent now', 'on call' and 'Jobs sent now': what is left is master text about other work (S2-30's example line, S2-31 'no jobs sent now', B6-16 behind the sent-now gate); (2) the example messages avoid the stop words (the Spanish call is about a dripping roof A/C and the danger-first question asks about gas or burning); (3) B3-11 and B3-18 are one conversation.
Keep: flush, leak (a roof or plumbing leak is the main RV repair), valve, drips, Trip fee, Towing (master text 'Work like towing or a lockout is sent now').
